name: Gratitude & Thanksgiving
overview: Scripture reveals gratitude and thanksgiving as responses rooted in recognizing God's providence and faithfulness, as seen when Eve acknowledges the man God has given her in Genesis 4:1, and when she names Seth as God's appointed seed in Genesis 4:25. The building of altars by Noah and Abram, as recorded in Genesis 8:20 and 12:7, demonstrates thanksgiving through worship and sacrifice, marking God's guidance and promises. Additionally, the blessing and tithe given to the Most High God in Genesis 14:20 reflect a heart of gratitude for divine deliverance and victory.
